claims.question: What environment variable must be set to enable API keys in Open WebUI, given they are off by default since 0.6.37?
claims.skill_answer: ENABLE_API_KEYS=true (the older ENABLE_API_KEY name is silently ignored)

claims.question: How long do Open WebUI JWTs remain valid by default since version 0.6.34?
What replaced the access_control field on Open WebUI resources in 0.10.0?
claims.skill_answer: access_grants: a list of {principal_type, principal_id, permission} objects

claims.question: Under Open WebUI 0.10.x access_grants, what does an absent access_grants field mean for a resource?
claims.skill_answer: Private; public requires an explicit user:* read grant

claims.question: What format does the Open WebUI config export use since 0.10.0?
claims.skill_answer: A flat dot-keyed dict, e.g. {"ui.default_models": ...}, not a nested blob

claims.question: Which environment variable must be true for Open WebUI to mount /docs and /openapi.json?
claims.skill_answer: ENV=dev; the Docker image ships ENV=prod

claims.question: What version does Open WebUI's openapi.json report in info.version?
What HTTP status and content does Open WebUI return for an unknown API path?
claims.skill_answer: HTTP 200 with the SPA's index.html (HTML-200 trap)

claims.question: Why does POST /api/v1/models/model/update return 500 in Open WebUI 0.11.0?
claims.skill_answer: access_grants omitted; send it explicitly, e.g. "access_grants": []

claims.question: How must custom_params values be encoded in Open WebUI model payloads?
claims.skill_answer: As JSON strings, e.g. {"reasoning": "{\"effort\": \"medium\"}"}, not nested objects

claims.question: Which environment variable enables the /api/v1/scim/v2 mount in Open WebUI?
What is the page-size cap for GET /api/v1/users/ and GET /api/v1/chats/?page= in Open WebUI 0.11.0?
claims.skill_answer: 30/page for users, 60/page for chats; no limit param
